name: Vampire Wars
source:
London England 1889 The Britannia Empire is ruled over by Her Royal Highness Queen Victoria.As the moon rises an evil force stalks the streets. In order to fight this evil Queen Victoria requests help from a shadow organisation that is formed by the beautiful Countess Vladimir the last royal Vampire.

[From [url=https://vampirewarsuk.itch.io/vampire-wars-symphony-of-darkness-]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1889年，英国伦敦。不列颠帝国由维多利亚女王统治。月亮升起时，一股邪恶势力在街头潜行。为了对抗这股邪恶势力，维多利亚女王向一个秘密组织求助。这个组织由美丽的弗拉基米尔女伯爵创立，她也是最后一位拥有王族血统的吸血鬼。

[摘自[url=https://vampirewarsuk.itch.io/vampire-wars-symphony-of-darkness-]Itch.io[/url]]
